sourceNote: reference/<sha>/src/index.html is film-engine's src/index.html at sourceCommit, so this repo checks itself without ../film-engine. To resync: bump sourceCommit, `git -C ../film-engine show <sha>:src/index.html > reference/<short>/src/index.html`, re-copy backend/ at the same sha, npm run split, npm test.
